stories.title: Chilly mornings, sunny days: Classic fall weather embraces the Carolinas
stories.summary: Chilly mornings and abundant sunshine define a classic mid-November stretch in the Carolinas, as high pressure ensures a steady warming trend through the workweek.

stories.title: Charlotte City Council moves forward with working group to guide $300M in I-77 toll lane benefits
stories.summary: The state has promised $300 million to support community benefits in impacted neighborhoods.

stories.title: Charlotte husband forgives driver accused in crash that killed his wife, injured children
stories.summary: After losing his wife in a crash involving an 18-year-old driver, Thomas Barringer embraces forgiveness over anger.

stories.title: New study examines lasting impact of operation Charlotte’s web on Charlotte’s Latino community
stories.summary: Camino researchers document stories of fear, financial hardship and resilience one year after federal immigration operation.

stories.title: Merle the elk passes away after sudden medical issue, Grandfather Mountain says
stories.summary: Christie Tipton, animal habitats curator for Grandfather Mountain Stewardship Foundation, said Merle was well loved and fought his medical issues until the end.

stories.title: 2 men arrested in multi-state hospital fraud scheme that began in NC
stories.summary: The duo persuaded Ashe Memorial Hospital staff to change its payment instructions and acquired over $196,000.

stories.title: Infant mortality rate slightly increases in South Carolina, report shows
stories.summary: There were 441 infant mortality cases in 2024, an increase from 7.0 to 7.5 deaths per 1,000 live births.

stories.title: Magical Toy Drive celebrates 26 years of helping Charlotte families during the holidays
stories.summary: WCNC Charlotte and The Salvation Army are once again teaming up to help thousands of local families put gifts under the tree this Christmas.

stories.title: Father, son hit by car while walking to Huntersville school
stories.summary: Investigators say the two passengers were not using a crosswalk, and the car that hit them illegally used a turn lane to get around stopped traffic.

stories.title: CMS to host transportation hiring event this week
stories.summary: CMS operates nearly 1,200 vehicles that cover over 99,000 miles daily.

stories.title: York County inmate dies after suffering medical emergency
stories.summary: The inmate was found unconscious and not breathing on Saturday evening.

stories.title: Crash causes major delays on I-77 in southwest Charlotte
stories.summary: Multiple lanes of I-77 South were blocked by a multi-vehicle crash near Remount Road on Monday morning.
